name: pdf-publish
description: PDF の生成・編集から納品までを品質ゲート付きで編成する出力パイプライン Skill。pdf-writer-mcp で書き、pdf-reader-mcp で読み戻し、pdf-verify-mcp (veraPDF) で機械採点する write → read-back → verify ループを回し、根拠付きの Publish Report を添えて納品する。PDF/UA-1 (アクセシブル PDF)・PDF/A-3 添付 (電帳法)・タグ付きフォーム修復に対応。pdf-trust (受入監査) の対になる送り出し側。pdf-writer-mcp が必須。
author: shuji-bonji

name: pdf-trust
description: PDF の信頼性監査オーケストレーション Skill。契約書・請求書・診療文書・行政文書などの PDF の真正性 (署名・改ざん・PAdES/PDF-A) を pdf-verify-mcp を軸に PDF family MCP を編成して判定し、ドメイン別プロファイルに基づく推奨判定付き Trust Report を返す。4 値判定は pdf-verify-mcp v0.7.0+ の evaluate_policy (決定論的ルールエンジン) に委譲し、Skill は解説・推奨アクション・法令根拠を担う。pdf-verify-mcp v0.10.0+ のリビジョン間オブジェクト単位差分と pdf-reader-mcp v0.10.0+ の locate_objects を組み合わせ、署名後に変わったオブジェクトをページ・矩形まで特定する。pdf-verify-mcp v0.21.0+ 推奨 (verify_signatures / detect_pades_level の最上位が配列から { scope, ... } になった版)。pdf-verify-mcp v0.27.0〜v0.28.0 で変わった失効と検証時刻の判定 (POL-CAUTION-REVOKED-AFTER-SIGNING・revocation_freshness) は pdf-trust v0.8.1 から、v0.29.0 の件数上限 (xxxTruncated) は v0.8.2 から読み分ける。pdf-verify-mcp plugin が必須。
author: shuji-bonji

name: pdf-read
description: 大きな PDF・読めない PDF から必要な箇所を取り出す読み取りオーケストレーション Skill。summarize で文書の性質 (ページ数・タグ・暗号化・ページごとのテキスト抽出可能性) を測ってから、構造経路 (extract_structured_text / extract_tables)・絞り込み経路 (search_text → pages 指定の read_text)・画像経路 (render_page = スキャン・図面・手書きを画像として読む) のいずれかで読み、読んだ範囲と読めなかった箇所を Read Report で申告する。空の抽出結果を「テキストが無い」と結論しないのが中核原則。pdf-trust (受入監査)・pdf-publish (納品) に対する 3 本目。pdf-reader-mcp v0.15.1+ 推奨（v0.14.0 の scope で「行われなかった読み」を読み分ける。v0.15.0 で暗号化文書の扱いが変わり、鍵が導ければ復号して読む。v0.15.1 で next の助言が観測と一致する）。
author: shuji-bonji

name: pdf-writer-mcp
description: PDF 生成・編集 MCP server。テキスト/Markdown/表からの PDF 生成、タグ付き PDF/UA-1 出力、PDF 2.0 出力、ページ操作・しおり・注釈・添付・透かし・フォーム、署名を保持する増分更新、PDF/A-3b / PDF/A-4 / PDF/A-4f の器付け (ensure_pdfa) を提供。**書けるのは「宣言」であって「適合」ではない** — 測ると落ちると分かっている宣言は declarationRisks として構造化して返す (v0.17.0)。ensure_pdfa と ensure_tagged は成功時にも、宣言を書いただけで適合は測っていないことを warnings で返す (ensure_tagged は v0.21.1 から)。npm @shuji-bonji/pdf-writer-mcp を npx で起動する。pdf-publish Skill の必須基盤。
author: shuji-bonji

name: pdf-verify-mcp
description: PDF 真正性検証 MCP server (7 tools)。電子署名の暗号学的検証 (CMS/PKCS#7)・改ざん検知 (リビジョン間のオブジェクト単位差分・リビジョン一覧が全履歴かの revisionChain・リビジョン数の食い違いに説明が付いているかの revisionCountAgreement を含む)・DocMDP 証明署名の権限判定 (ISO 32000-2 Table 257 に沿って P=1/2/3 ごとに変更の種類を照合。判定できない場合は indeterminate = pass ではない)・PAdES レベル判定 (B-B/B-T/B-LT/B-LTA)・PDF/A (PDF/A-1〜4) と PDF/UA (PDF/UA-1/2) の適合性検証・ISO 32000 本体条文の制約検査 (validate_clauses = フォント埋め込み / メタデータ / 注釈の 3 ドメイン・26 制約。veraPDF が見ない領域)・決定論的ルールエンジンによる 4 値判定 (evaluate_policy) を提供。v0.27.0 から、証明書の有効期間と失効の判定に使う時刻を署名タイムスタンプ → 文書タイムスタンプ → 現在時刻の順で選び (ISO 32000-2 §12.8.3.4.5・§12.8.3.4.6)、失効した署名者証明書はタイムスタンプが失効より前を示すときだけ revoked_after_validation_time、それ以外は verdict: indeterminate になる。v0.28.0 から、失効情報は既定 24 時間より古ければ good の根拠にしない (revocation_freshness)。v0.29.0 から、JSON の応答を文字数で切らず、配列ごとの件数上限を超えたときは xxxTruncated: { returned, total } を添える。npm @shuji-bonji/pdf-verify-mcp を npx で起動する。pdf-trust Skill の必須基盤。
author: shuji-bonji

name: pdf-reader-mcp
description: PDF 構造解析 MCP server (19 tools)。テキスト・画像・表の抽出、署名フィールド・フォント・注釈・タグ構造の inspect、描画座標への変換 (オブジェクト番号は locate_objects、構造要素は extract_structured_text の include_bbox。いずれも pdf-writer-mcp add_annotation がそのまま取る形)、PDF/UA タグ検証を提供。v0.12.0: テキストを返す全ツールがページごとの**テキスト抽出可能性** (extracted / no_text_layer / not_extractable / not_observed, ISO 32000-2 §9.10.1) を申告し、空の抽出結果が「テキストが無い」と取り違えられない。read_images は本物の PNG/JPEG を MCP image content block で返し (視覚モデルがそのまま読める)、render_page がページを画像として描画する (PDFium-WASM = optionalDependencies @hyzyla/pdfium。未導入でも他 18 ツールは動作)。summarize は観測から決まる次の一手 (next) を返す。 v0.14.0: テキストを返す全ツールが **scope**（その答えの背後にある 2 つの読み——ページから文字を取り出すこと・その文字が Unicode に変換できるかの観測——のどちらが行われたか）を申告し、行われなかった読みの項目は `0` や `false` や空文字ではなく **null** になる。「読んでいない」が「読んで無かった」の顔をしない。read_url は取得したバイト列を 2 人の読み手に配るようになり（v0.13.0 までは全件が失敗していた）、render_page は 1 ページ 20 秒の予算を別スレッドで置くので、ラスタライズが終わらないページがあってもサーバは応答を返し続ける。 v0.15.0: pdf-lib を外し、読み取りは @normativepdf/recover を通る。空のユーザーパスワードで鍵が導ける暗号化文書は復号して読み、inspect_structure の objectStats.byType / catalog[].type は pdf-lib のクラス名ではなく COS 型名 (ISO 32000-2 §7.3) を返す。

name: pdf-spec-mcp
description: ISO 32000 (PDF 仕様) の構造化参照 MCP server。条項検索・要求事項 (MUST/SHOULD) 抽出・定義取得・版間比較を提供。ISO 仕様 PDF は利用者が用意し PDF_SPEC_DIR で指定する。収録対象は ISO 32000-1/-2 を中心とする PDF 関連 17 文書で、PDF/A (ISO 19005) と PAdES (ETSI EN 319 142) は対象外 (list_specs の coverage.gaps)。検索が当たらないことは「要件が無い」ではなく「ここでは答えられない」を意味する。v0.5.0: 検索索引と要件の全走査を初回構築後にディスクへキャッシュし (既定 ~/.cache/pdf-spec-mcp、PDF_SPEC_CACHE_DIR で変更・PDF_SPEC_CACHE=off で無効)、以後のプロセスは 1 秒未満で応答する。`--build-cache` CLI で全仕様を事前構築できる。**本サーバは条文の参照であって適合判定器ではありません** — PDF ファイルの検査や適合判定は行わず、それは pdf-verify-mcp の役割です。

name: pdf-specialist

name: rxjs-mcp
description: RxJS ストリームの実行・可視化・検査を行う MCP server (6 tools)。execute_stream は RxJS しか持たない worker thread でスニペットを評価し、発行値・タイムライン・所要時間を返す (プロジェクトのコードは動かない)。generate_marble は ASCII マーブルダイアグラムを描く。analyze_operators / suggest_pattern は RxJS 7.8.2 に固定した同梱データを引き、rxjs.dev・GitHub ソース・バイリンガルガイドの 3 階層リンクを付ける。lint_rxjs は eslint-plugin-rxjs-x の recommended/strict ルールを正規表現で再実装したもので、ESLint を導入せずスニペット単体を検査できる。detect_memory_leak は takeUntilDestroyed / async pipe / useEffect cleanup 等の自動クリーンアップを認識する。**lint_rxjs と detect_memory_leak は型情報を持たない照合であり、プロジェクトでの ESLint 実行を置き換えるものではない**。npm @shuji-bonji/rxjs-mcp を npx で起動する。

description: Elektronik ticaret: 6563 sayılı Kanun — hizmet/aracı hizmet sağlayıcı yükümlülükleri, ticari elektronik ileti ve İYS, mesafeli sözleşmeler ve tüketici hakları, platform düzenlemesi ve uyum.

name: basin-medya-hukuku

author: Aydın Can Polatkan

name: goc-yabancilar-hukuku
description: Yabancılar ve uluslararası koruma: 6458 sayılı Kanun — ikamet izinleri, sınır dışı etme ve idari gözetim, uluslararası koruma başvurusu, çalışma izni ve vatandaşlık; idari dava yolları.
author: Aydın Can Polatkan

name: hukuk-muhakemesi
description: Medeni yargılama: 6100 sayılı HMK — dava şartları ve ilk itirazlar, görev ve yetki, dilekçeler ve ön inceleme, ispat yükü ve deliller, tahkikat ve hüküm, istinaf/temyiz; usul denetim şeması.
author: Aydın Can Polatkan

name: icra-iflas-hukuku
description: İcra ve iflas: 2004 sayılı İİK — ilamlı/ilamsız takip, ödeme emrine itiraz ve itirazın iptali/kaldırılması, kambiyo senetlerine özgü takip, haciz ve satış, sıra cetveli, iflas yolları.
author: Aydın Can Polatkan

name: konkordato-yeniden-yapilandirma
description: Konkordato hukuku: geçici ve kesin mühlet, konkordato komiseri ve alacaklılar kurulu, projenin hazırlanması ve tasdiki, sözleşmesel yeniden yapılandırma; mali güçlük yönetimi.

name: tahkim-arabuluculuk
description: Alternatif uyuşmazlık çözümü: iç ve milletlerarası tahkim (4686/HMK), tahkim sözleşmesi ve hakem kararının iptali/tenfizi; 6325 sayılı HUAK kapsamında ihtiyari ve dava şartı arabuluculuk.

name: dava-dilekce-atolyesi
description: Layiha üretimi: HMK/İYUK/CMK'ya uygun dava, cevap, replik-düplik, istinaf ve temyiz dilekçeleri; vakıa-hukuki sebep-talep sonucu mimarisi, delil bağlama ve [doldurulacak] yer tutucu disiplini.

name: hukuki-mutalaa
description: Hukuki mütalaa ve görüş yazımı: olayın tespiti, hukuki sorunun çerçevelenmesi, mevzuat-içtihat-doktrin değerlendirmesi (altlama), seçeneklerin tartılması ve gerekçeli sonuç; risk haritası ve eylem önerisi.
author: Aydın Can Polatkan

name: avukatlik-meslek-kurallari
description: Avukatlık hukuku: 1136 sayılı Kanun ve meslek kuralları — sır saklama, çıkar çatışması, vekâlet sözleşmesi ve ücret, reklam yasağı, disiplin sorumluluğu; büroda uyum ve etik denetim.
author: Aydın Can Polatkan

name: hukuk-burosu-yonetimi
description: Hukuk bürosu işletmesi: müvekkil kabulü ve çıkar çatışması taraması, dosya ve süre yönetimi, vekâlet ücreti ve tahsilat, büro KVKK uyumu, iş akışı ve kalite kontrol panoları.
author: Aydın Can Polatkan

name: dava-dosya-takip
description: Dava dosyası işleme: yapılandırılmış dosya özeti, taraf-vekil ve süre takvimi, vakıa kronolojisi, delil dizini ve eksik/çelişki listesi; dosyaya hızlı hâkim olmayı sağlayan Excel'lenebilir çıktılar.
author: Aydın Can Polatkan

name: sozlesme-inceleme-redline
description: Sözleşme inceleme: madde madde risk analizi, eksik/asimetrik/geçersiz şart tespiti, redline önerileri ve alternatif lafızlar, müzakere notu ve risk skoru; TBK ve emredici hükümler süzgeci.
author: Aydın Can Polatkan

name: kvkk-uyum-checker
description: KVKK uyum tarayıcısı: veri işleme envanteri, aydınlatma ve açık rıza metinleri, saklama-imha politikası, aktarım ve VERBİS kontrolü; uyum boşluğu raporu ve eylem planı çıktısı.
author: Aydın Can Polatkan

name: kendini-temsil-asliye
description: Vekille temsil edilmeyen tarafa rehber: küçük alacak ve sulh hukuk uyuşmazlıkları, tüketici hakem heyeti başvurusu, dilekçe ve delil hazırlığı, duruşma hazırlığı; hukuki danışmanlık yerine geçmez.
author: Aydın Can Polatkan

name: bilirkisi-rapor-inceleme
description: Bilirkişi raporu analizi: görevlendirme kapsamına uygunluk, metodoloji ve dayanak denetimi, hesap ve maddi hata kontrolü, çelişki tespiti; gerekçeli itiraz ve ek rapor/yeni bilirkişi talebi taslağı.
author: Aydın Can Polatkan

name: sade-hukuk-dili
description: Sade hukuk dili: karmaşık dilekçe, karar ve sözleşmeleri müvekkilin anlayacağı yalın Türkçeye çevirme; hukuki doğruluğu koruyarak özetleme, terim açıklama ve bilgilendirme metni üretimi.
author: Aydın Can Polatkan

name: scriptorium
description: Coordinated AI capabilities for manuscripts, grants, and reviews. Reads and writes a shared MANUSCRIPT_STATE.yaml so skills compose rather than each starting from scratch.
author: Sean Davis

name: conversiontools
description: Convert files between 140+ formats using Conversion Tools. Two surfaces - the ctio CLI (preferred when shell access is available) and the hosted MCP server (zero-install). Documents, data formats (incl. Parquet), images (incl. JXL), audio, video, e-books, OCR, AI extraction, text-to-speech (TTS), speech-to-text (STT), subtitles (SRT, VTT, ASS), and website screenshots.
author: conversiontools

name: citadel
description: Route requests, preserve run state, enforce hooks, and surface reviewable evidence in Claude Code
author: SethGammon

name: ogxo
description: The ogxo plugin set in one install: code review, git and GitHub workflows, browser debugging, decision and planning skills, color-system design, safety hooks, specialist subagents, the status line, and model routing. Installing it installs each of those plugins; thryx (needs a ThryX account) and ogxo-format (rewrites every file Claude edits) are left out and install on their own.
author: ogxo

name: thryx
description: Skills for ThryX project management over MCP: issues, projects, cycles, milestones, the client-facing macro board, and documents in the ThryX workspaces you connect, plus a product-management skill for writing tickets, PRDs, ADRs, and project docs and running follow-ups.
author: ogxo

name: ogxo-review
description: Multi-agent code review: full-review cross-correlates several reviewers and filters false positives; code-review-git posts line-level findings as a GitHub PR review and answers other reviewers' comments. Bundles the code-review-agent, security-auditor, code-metrics-analyst, and finding-verifier agents; code-review-git verifies every finding before it is shown. Also security-check, a focused security review of a branch, and the dependency-auditor agent.
author: ogxo

name: ogxo-git
description: Git and GitHub workflow skills: Conventional Commit messages, PR titles and descriptions with template detection, resolving PR review threads (its workflow instructs it to present its analysis and wait for approval before replying or resolving), and a catchup command to restore branch context. Also release, quick-fix, and ship-feature workflows, and changelog-generator and release-notes skills.
author: ogxo

name: ogxo-debug
description: Debug a running web app by driving the browser: reproduce the symptom, read console and network errors, fix, and verify in the page. Also css-alignment-debug, which injects temporary outline overlays and reads a screenshot of the rendered page for layout bugs that won't resolve from reading source. Also browser-testing: Playwright test scripts with dev-server detection; Playwright installs into the plugin's data directory during a one-time setup.
author: ogxo

name: ogxo-decide
description: War room: multi-persona deliberation for hard-to-reverse decisions, with game-theory lenses, a red-team pass, and a portfolio of options instead of a single winner. Also prd-create (section-by-section PRDs with pressure-testing, optionally saved to ThryX as a document plus epic and stories), task-architect (turns an idea into an agent-ready prompt), and the architecture-advisor agent. Also diagram-generator: Mermaid diagrams from a description or from the codebase.
author: ogxo

name: ogxo-design
description: Recolor: audit an app's color usage, then implement a cohesive, accessible, token-based color system grounded in color theory, with contrast ratios computed by a bundled script.
author: ogxo

name: ogxo-guards
description: Safety hooks: reject a `git add` that would stage a .env, key, certificate, or credentials file (the pathspecs it names, and for broad adds what git status lists), reject Edit/Write calls on lock files and on node_modules/, vendor/, and .git/ paths, and reject single file writes over 1,048,576 characters. Pattern-based, so it does not catch everything; see the README. Requires jq.
author: ogxo

name: ogxo-format
description: Formatting hooks after every Edit/Write: format the changed file with prettier, gofmt, rustfmt, or black when found, whether or not the project uses that formatter; report trailing whitespace back to Claude; and check YAML syntax. Requires jq.
author: ogxo

name: ogxo-specialists
description: Specialist subagents that take a noisy job and return one structured report: log-analyst (correlate logs to a root cause), codebase-archaeologist (map an unfamiliar or legacy system), performance-optimizer (measure, fix by impact, re-measure), and migration-specialist (breaking-change catalog and a phased plan with rollback points).
author: ogxo

name: ogxo-statusline
description: Status line for Claude Code and Grok Build: model, context use, git branch and changes, session time, effort, output tokens, and session cost. Claude Code also shows thinking, prompt-cache state, and 5-hour, 7-day, and spend-limit bars. Grok Build uses the live context window, session output and cache-read share, and the active turn. /ogxo-statusline:setup writes Claude settings; /ogxo-statusline:setup-grok writes [ui.status_line] in the Grok user config. Requires jq.
author: ogxo

name: ogxo-route
description: Cost-aware routing for Claude Code: a routing skill and session-start summary that tell the main session which tier handles which task, worker subagents pinned to Sonnet or Haiku with explicit tool lists, hooks that warn when a generic subagent is dispatched without a model, log each dispatch and permission request, and count advisor calls, plus opt-in alerts when Claude Code waits on a permission prompt and an opt-in live HTML board of a session's agents and tool calls. Risky work and reviews stay at Opus or above. Warns, never blocks. Claude Code only. Requires jq.
author: ogxo

name: video-kit
description: Make launch videos, feature teasers, social clips and what's-new videos for your product, from its code or just its website, scene by scene or cinematic with 3D, silent or narrated, then watch and tweak them live in your browser: /video-kit:make, /video-kit:website, /video-kit:voiceover and /video-kit:changelog. Built for anyone, no video skills needed.
author: Dodera Software

name: pr-podcast
description: Turn a pull request, today's commits, a release or a date range into a 3–5 minute two-voice audio episode: what changed, why, and what's risky. Listen before opening the diff, play it at standup, or catch up after time off. Recorded on your computer with free, open voices: /pr-podcast:make, /pr-podcast:standup, /pr-podcast:release and /pr-podcast:catchup.
author: Dodera Software

name: oculpm
description: ocul-pm 훅 브리지(세션 신호) + oculpm-mcp(journal/plan 구조화 도구) + 스킬 5종(기록 규격·인셉션·self-audit·run-evals·tdd). .oculpm 추적 프로젝트에서만 동작합니다. macOS · Linux · Windows(베타 — Windows 훅은 Git Bash 필요, Windows 의 MCP 는 앱의 MCP 등록으로).
author: ocul-pm

name: outlook
description: Microsoft 365 mail and calendar, run from your agent - read, search, send, manage drafts and attachments, and check availability. Also turns a PST archive into searchable markdown with a SHA256 chain of custody over every message.
author: DBHQ

name: trello
description: Trello skill pack for Claude Code and Codex over the Trello REST API - boards, lists and cards end to end, a status digest for a board, and a radar for what is due across every board.
author: DBHQ

name: legwork
description: Research that settles a decision, and says when it cannot. A source is judged by the claim it backs, sources only corroborate when they could have disagreed, and every finding states how well it is supported.
author: DBHQ

name: dovetail
description: Checks whether a repository still agrees with itself - dead links, moved anchors, orphaned files and duplicated content from seventeen deterministic checks, and contradictions and stale documentation from model reviewers. The checks need no model and no network, and by default only proven findings gate a build.
author: DBHQ

name: verve
description: Strips AI tells from prose and puts a human voice back, in British or American English, pitched at the reader you name. A two-way politeness check catches both talking down to them and going cold. Meaning is a veto: every figure, name and claim survives. Prose only - no packages, no network, no paid tier.
author: DBHQ

name: vela
description: Compiler-exact code search over a SCIP index - where a symbol is defined, every reference, its direct callers and what implements it. .NET is indexed natively through Roslyn, with Razor and Blazor references resolved by the compiler into a saved index; any other language reaches the same database through its own SCIP indexer. The plugin installs the skill; the vela command comes from the repository's installer.
author: DBHQ

name: garmin
description: Garmin Connect health and fitness data from your agent - Body Battery, HRV, resting heart rate, stress, sleep stages and score, activities, VO2 max, training load, status and readiness. name: block-invisible-unicode

Escape: 'pragma: allowlist invisible-unicode' on the same line. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. name: pin-github-actions
description: The mechanizable slice of CI supply-chain hardening, enforced at two points: at commit (the git hook, over staged changes) and at agent tool-use (over a tool call's arguments, as the agent writes) -- a workflow that references a third-party GitHub Action by a movable ref -- a branch or a version tag -- instead of a full 40-character commit SHA. The guard refuses shell writes to those paths -- a redirect, rm/mv/tee/sed -i, cp into the path, git checkout/restore, PowerShell Set-Content/Add-Content/Out-File; reads and copies out pass, and `chock sync` passes. name: protect-commit-privacy
description: Keep the development conversation out of git history. Agent-authored commits narrate by default -- who asked for what, which discussion decided it, what the plan was -- and on a public repo that narration is published forever. The guard refuses git commit commands whose message (inline -m/--message or the file behind -F/--file) contains process-leak markers; the rule tells the agent to describe the change, not the conversation, and to propose sensitive messages to the human before committing. The command line is parsed, so a commit or gh pr create|edit behind cd, sh -c/bash -c, sudo, env or command is read like a bare one, a message fed on `-F -` from a heredoc is scanned, and a command that merely echoes the pattern as documentation still passes. A commit-msg hook applies the same markers to the message git records. Best-effort: markers are a narrow deny-list, and a message the human explicitly approves can say anything -- edit the marker list in the guard, the content is yours. [Session-enforced via a PreToolUse hook; needs git, a usable bash and a Python 3.11+ (python3, python or py, whichever actually runs; the Windows Store stub is skipped). With no working Python the hook refuses (exit 2); without git or bash, fail-open clients allow silently and fail-closed clients refuse matched commands. If the guard itself crashes or times out, the hook asks for confirmation rather than allowing silently.]
author: open-coder-ai

name: protect-main-branch

author: open-coder-ai

name: protect-test-integrity
description: Blocks a commit that turns tests green by weakening them instead of fixing the code: a deleted test file, a net loss of assertions across the change, or a vacuous assertion (assert True, expect(true).toBe(true)) added in place of a real one. Covers Python, JS/TS, Go and Java test layouts. Mechanised slice of agent-discipline's never(fix_test_by) rule; added skips are block-test-skips. Enforced at commit and at agent tool-use (an edit that weakens a test is judged against the file on disk, the turn's end against HEAD; Edit and Write cannot delete a file). A reviewed exception carries 'chock: allow test-integrity' on an added line of the test file; a waiver is honoured at commit only, never in the agent. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo.]
author: open-coder-ai

name: rtk-dangerous-actions-blocker
description: Carved out for rtk-ai/rtk#1007: rtk's own decision table as a chock policy (rtk's own hooks may not block). Refuses rm -rf on root, home, parent or absolute paths; git push --force and '+' refspecs (not --force-with-lease); reads of credential files (.env, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws) by cat, grep, rg, awk, sed, jq and the like or by `< file`, and echoes or inline literals of *_API_KEY/*_SECRET/*_TOKEN; DROP/TRUNCATE/unscoped DELETE through psql, mysql, sqlite3, mongosh, redis-cli, and dropdb; plus the base policy's cloud rows (kubectl delete, terraform destroy, aws s3 rm --recursive, helm uninstall, gcloud delete, docker volume rm). Asks where rtk's table says ask: rm -rf on a relative path off the safe list; git reset --hard, clean -f, checkout ., branch -D; docker prune and docker rm -f over a substitution. File checks are skipped inside docker/kubectl exec; rtk is a transparent prefix. Friction, not a security boundary. [Session-enforced via a PreToolUse hook; needs git, a usable bash and a Python 3.11+ (python3, python or py, whichever actually runs; the Windows Store stub is skipped). With no working Python the hook refuses (exit 2); without git or bash, fail-open clients allow silently and fail-closed clients refuse matched commands. If the guard itself crashes or times out, the hook asks for confirmation rather than allowing silently.]
author: open-coder-ai

name: scan-secrets
description: Blocks known credential patterns -- vendor key prefixes, private-key blocks, and key/token/password assignments -- at two enforcement points: at commit (the git hook, over staged changes) and at agent tool-use (the mcp-gateway / agent write guard, over a tool call's arguments), so a secret is caught as the agent writes it, before it ever reaches a commit. Matched by pattern, not by entropy analysis. Best-effort guard; not a replacement for a dedicated secret scanner. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. description: Block hallucinated or unknown dependencies before they enter the repo. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo.]
author: open-coder-ai

name: verify-mcp-allowlist
description: Gate MCP server configuration as protected content. A shell write to .mcp.json is refused unless every mcpServers entry on the line, parsed as JSON, matches a name+source pair on the allowlist -- an unlisted name blocks, and an allowed name whose command/args/url changed blocks too. `claude mcp add|add-json` is checked the same way (add-from-claude-desktop cannot be verified and is refused). The allowlist ships inside this guard's own script, protected like every policy's implementations/ source -- edit only with 'chock: approved-config-change'. The shell guard reads Claude Code's .mcp.json, best-effort (PreToolUse fails open on a crash; a write with no visible content fails closed). A script gate at commit and tool use parses every written MCP config (.mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json, .vscode/mcp.json, claude_desktop_config.json, .gemini/settings.json, .codex/config.toml) against the same allowlist; only servers the change adds or alters are refused, at commit and tool use. No pragma. [Session-enforced via a PreToolUse hook; needs git, a usable bash and a Python 3.11+ (python3, python or py, whichever actually runs; the Windows Store stub is skipped). Once you trust that loop, /sonu:factory turns your issue tracker into the queue: label a ticket in GitHub Issues, Jira, Linear, or a dependency-free local Markdown store, and the agent specs it, builds it in its own git worktree so several tickets can run in parallel, and — once you review the diff and apply the ship label — takes it through review to a merged PR, reporting plan, progress, and risks back to the ticket the whole way. Run a pass per label, or let /sonu:factory poll watch the queue for you. You approve the spec, the diff, and the ship — nothing merges without your label. It also knows what a good interface looks like: /sonu:interface-review audits a whole screen or flow across accessibility, layout, typography, color, motion, and copy, and those same bars fire automatically while it builds. The discipline lives in 26 skills that auto-apply as it works, and that you can read and edit like any other file: code-standards, tdd, debugging, security, performance, intent-interview, design-tree, model-tiering, self-review, blast-radius, pr-conventions, safe-migrations, infra-standards, observability, seo, interface-review, accessibility, layout, ui-polish, typography, colors, ux-writing, ticket-lifecycle, ticket-triage, classify-tickets, bug-finder. Every skill is plain Markdown you can read, fork, and edit — no runtime, no service to sign up for. Works in Claude Code and Cursor. The local tracker needs nothing but git; GitHub Issues uses the gh CLI, and Jira and Linear use their MCP servers or your own API credentials.

Bundles pure-stdlib triage scripts (payload identifier, raw-Protobuf decoder, TLV parser, IL2CPP metadata probe). Forces transcribe-before-you-judge review of the ACTUAL rendered UI (Xcode/SwiftUI, web, Electron, mockups), a Stop hook that blocks 'done' when UI was edited/screenshotted but never reviewed, an automated QC command, and an independent adversarial reviewer subagent. Stops 'compiles → screenshot → looks good → done' from shipping obvious defects.
author: logicleap-labs

name: verify-before-done
description: Blocks 'done' when code changed but nothing was run to verify it. Skill + Stop hook: require test/build/lint/smoke evidence or VERIFY-BEFORE-DONE: PASS. Stops 'edited the handler → should work → done' without proof.
author: logicleap-labs

name: scope-guard
description: Keeps an agent in its lane. Declare the files a task may touch (a .scope-guard file, an env var, or a SCOPE-GUARD: sentinel) and a PreToolUse hook blocks any Edit/Write outside that set — stopping drive-by edits, 'while I'm here' refactors, and one agent clobbering another's files on a shared tree.
author: logicleap-labs

name: no-stub
description: Blocks 'done' when the code you just wrote is half-written. Skill + Stop hook: detect stub/placeholder markers — TODO/FIXME, NotImplementedError, empty `...` bodies, 'your code here' — in code edited this turn, and refuse the turn until it's real or marked NO-STUB: INTENTIONAL. Stops 'scaffold the function → leave a TODO → done' from shipping.
author: logicleap-labs

name: accessibility-gate
description: Stops UI work being called done before a real accessibility pass. The Stop hook requires evidence for keyboard flow, visible focus, accessible names, contrast, reduced motion, and error/loading states.
author: logicleap-labs

name: secret-guard
description: Stops a live secret from ever landing in source. A PreToolUse hook scans the new content of every Edit/Write for real-looking credentials — AWS keys, GitHub/OpenAI/Stripe/Slack tokens, Google keys, private keys, hardcoded api_key literals — and blocks the write before it hits a tracked file. Allows .env files, placeholders, and env reads (process.env / os.environ); fails open.
author: logicleap-labs

name: no-slop
description: Blocks 'done' when the prose you just wrote reads like AI slop. Skill + Stop hook: detect high-precision AI tells — 'delve into', 'it's worth noting that', 'a testament to', 'navigate the complexities', 'rich tapestry', em-dash pile-ups — in prose edited this turn (.md/.mdx/.txt/.rst), and refuse the turn until it's plain or marked NO-SLOP: INTENTIONAL. The prose complement to no-stub. Stops 'write the README → pad it with clichés → done' from shipping.
author: logicleap-labs

name: no-debug
description: Blocks 'done' when the code you just wrote still has leftover debug noise. Skill + Stop hook: detect high-signal debug markers — console.log/debugger, pdb.set_trace/breakpoint, binding.pry/byebug, dd()/var_dump, dbg!(), debug-ish prints — in code edited this turn, and refuse the turn until it's stripped or marked NO-DEBUG: INTENTIONAL. Lets console.error/warn and real loggers through. Stops 'add a console.log to check → forget it → done' from shipping.
author: logicleap-labs

name: no-swallow
description: Blocks 'done' when the code you just wrote silently swallows an error. Skill + Stop hook: detect caught exceptions that are neither handled, logged, re-raised, nor returned — `except: pass`, empty `catch (e) {}`, `.catch(() => {})`, empty `if err != nil {}` — in code edited this turn, and refuse the turn until the error is dealt with or marked NO-SWALLOW: INTENTIONAL. Heuristic and fail-open: a handler that logs, re-raises, returns, or sets error state is never flagged; Swift try? and fallback imports pass. Stops 'wrap it in a try so it stops crashing → leave the catch empty → done' from shipping.
author: logicleap-labs

name: no-silent-assumptions
description: Blocks 'done' when the turn rests on unsurfaced guesses. Skill + Stop hook: track material assumptions while working — environment, data shape, API behavior, edge cases — and surface them in a short 'Assumptions:' block before claiming done; the hook detects guess-shaped language ('assuming the…', 'not sure if…', 'probably works', 'TODO: verify') in code added this turn and refuses the turn until they're surfaced or marked NO-SILENT-ASSUMPTIONS: INTENTIONAL. Conservative and fail-open: only multi-word guess phrases fire, never bare words. Stops 'infer the schema → assume it holds → done' from shipping a silent risk.
author: logicleap-labs

name: migration-safety
description: Stops destructive DB work from running before the plan exists. A PreToolUse hook blocks destructive SQL — DROP TABLE/COLUMN, TRUNCATE, DELETE/UPDATE without WHERE, irreversible ALTERs — in Bash commands or migration-file writes unless a migration plan is declared (.migration-plan file, or MIGRATION-SAFETY: ALLOW sentinel stating target, dry-run, rollback). The skill teaches the method: state target → dry-run → rollback plan → then execute. WHERE-scoped deletes, additive migrations, and SQL in docs pass; fails open. Stops 'clean up the old rows → forget the WHERE → gone' from ever running.
